description: This Kotlin source file defines the TaskViewModel class, which manages UI-related data and logic for task management, including creating, editing, saving, deleting, and toggling tasks within an Android application.

classes.name: TaskEditorState
classes.description: Data class representing the state of a task editor, including task id, title, description, and completion status.

classes.name: TaskViewModel
classes.description: ViewModel class that manages task data and operations for the UI, interfacing with TaskRepository.

methods.name: startCreate
methods.description: Resets the editor state to create a new task.

methods.name: startEdit
methods.description: Populates the editor with data from an existing task for editing.

methods.name: updateTitle
methods.description: Updates the title in the editor state.

methods.name: updateDescription
methods.description: Updates the description in the editor state.

methods.name: updateCompleted
methods.description: Updates the completed status in the editor state.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current editor state as a new or existing task.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a task by its ID.

methods.name: toggleCompleted
methods.description: Toggles the completion status of a task.
